# Feature: Bomb block — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #83 (Bomb block) from Blocks before it is used in real levels. Effect: push into a wall to crack it. Unique: the only block that destroys a wall. Useful: opens a route no key or switch can. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** push into a wall to crack it.

**So that** opens a route no key or switch can.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Bomb block for the first time in its teaching room (mech-83-bomb-block-room). Teaching moment: First room: one bomb block facing two walls, only one of which hides the exit. A player who pushes it into the nearest wall spends the bomb on solid rock and must restart, which teaches that the wall a bomb is spent on is a choice rather than a formality. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It moves only onto empty floor or a switch plate, exactly as a push block (81)
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Water, deep water, void, fire and lava block it; it never enters or covers them
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: When a push would drive it into a wall, it explodes instead: that wall tile becomes floor and the bomb block is consumed
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It only cracks walls, not locks, closed gates or other blocks

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It moves only onto empty floor or a switch plate, exactly as a push block (81)
- Water, deep water, void, fire and lava block it; it never enters or covers them
- When a push would drive it into a wall, it explodes instead: that wall tile becomes floor and the bomb block is consumed
- It only cracks walls, not locks, closed gates or other blocks
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Bomb block's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-83-bomb-block-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/blocks.yml mechanic #83.
